player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely declared "DONE" while in the Kitchen, failing to realize that the "south" direction had not yet been explored from that room. My previous strategy relied on a simple depth-first approach without tracking which specific directions had been successfully traversed from each room. Next time, I will maintain a mental map of visited rooms and, crucially, a list of untried directions for every room I enter. Before issuing "DONE", I will verify that every reachable room has been visited and that no untried directions remain in any room I have accessed. Specifically, upon returning to the Kitchen, I will check if "south" has been tried; if not, I will execute "GO: south" instead of stopping.
